name: Managed fix
description: A bounded fix with an explicit write scope, no commit authority, and controller-owned verification. Fork this pipeline into .bachata/pipelines to point verification at a repository verifier declared in .bachata/verifiers.json.

roles.name: Worker
roles.instructions: Implement the requested fix completely inside the declared write scope. Do not run repository commands, acceptance suites, or shared-resource checks. The controller owns verification and Git.

steps.name: Implement the bounded fix
steps.promptTemplate:
Diagnose and implement the fix for this request. Stay inside the declared write scope. Do not create commits and do not run repository commands: the controller owns verification and Git.

{{userPrompt}}

steps.name: Surface material decisions
steps.promptTemplate:
Name only the material judgments this work leaves to the human. A judgment is material when the repository evidence cannot settle it, or when settling it commits the project to a direction a human owns.

Return JSON only: {"decisions": [...]}. Return an empty list when the work raised no such judgment; an empty list is the correct and common answer. Do not restate findings, operational blockers, provider errors, or choices this work already made on its own authority.

Every decision needs a stable subject, the actual question, the affected scope, and the evidence you are relying on. Supply options, trade-offs, and a recommendation only when the work genuinely produced them. Never invent an option, a trade-off, evidence, a scope, or a recommendation to fill a field.
